public_nonduplicate_tasks.evidence: 1,500 released VQA questions with distinct image-geometry tuples; 899 released source images.

relevant_foundation_model.evidence: Intern-S1 is a named multimodal scientific foundation model with reported materials relevance; benchmark-specific MATCHA benefit is not established.

harbor.evidence: All 100 frozen tasks were scheduled through Harbor with real images; pilot transport recordings matched staged images byte-for-byte.

deepseek_binary_accuracy.evidence: 70/100 full-credit binary successes over all scheduled attempts; no missing rewards. Precommitted 98.333% Wilson and paper-cluster intervals cross the strict 70% ceiling. The frozen expansion was stopped only after verifier failure became definitive; completed attempts are retained and never rerun.

verifier_false_positive.evidence: 28/100 released labels accepted by the exact-letter verifier were independently judged scientifically indefensible. All 100 frozen first-cohort tasks remain in the denominator; six unresolved tasks conservatively count as non-errors.

verifier_false_negative.evidence: 28/100 tasks had at least one independently adjudicated scientifically defensible non-gold option rejected by the exact-letter verifier. Each task contributes at most one error.

audit_independence: GPT-5.1 received released figures, questions, and all choices but not gold labels or verifier outcomes. It could abstain as ambiguous. Rates are independent of DeepSeek solver accuracy.
stop_reason: Both complete-cohort task-level verifier rates are 28%, strictly above the 15% ceiling; stop costly accuracy expansion.
